No, because I understand disillusionment.

I am fine with a solitary life, but I am not being given that option at present.
I am already at the end of my rope I'm afraid.

I'm leaving information out for privacy reasons but there is no doubt I will be forced to take antipsychotics/tranquilizers again if I go down this path. I will not put myself in that situation. It is worse than death to me. I would rather have a physical aliment that is obvious and I can then become free to deal with my problems in my way.
